newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PEN PICTURES OF PARIS ST GERMAIN PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEN PICTURES OF PARIS ST GERMAIN PLAYERS.

text.p: Pen pictures of Paris St Germain players ahead of Wednesday's European Cup Winners' Cup final against Barcelona in Rotterdam:

Bernard Lama, goalkeeper, age 33. France's first choice in goal, but, after knee surgery in October, lost some of his touch. Faces a two-month suspension from French federation for smoking cannabis. Decision will be made the day after the final.
Jimmy Algerino, right back, 25. Former Monaco player who has recently won a regular place in the team this season. But he may be dropped in favour of experienced Laurent Fournier.

Bruno Ngotty, central defender,25. French international who will be in charge of stopping Ronaldo. Tall, heavy and fast -- he runs the 100 metres inside 11 seconds -- he usually shines against the best. Also dangerous on long range free kicks.
Paul Le Guen, centre-back, 32. Another veteran defender widely considered past his best. Sluggish at times but plays a key role in anchoring the team.
Didier Domi, left back, 18. Product of PSG youth scheme who has won a place in the team following the departure of Jose Cobos to Espanyol of Barcelona.
Daniel Kenedy, full-back or defensive midfielder, 22. Joined PSG from Benfica in off-season but has had a mixed season with injury problems and been unable to hold down a regular first team place.
Laurent Fournier, midfielder or right back, 32. Former Marseille player who appeared in the 1991 European Cup final. Temperamental, he is also a relentless fighter with a lor of experience.
Benoit Cauet, defensive midfielder, 27. Vital for PSG as a ballwinner, can also play at full back. Won French league title with former clubs Marseille and Nantes.

Vincent Guerin, attacking midfielder, 31. Busy France international who on good days is the team's motor. He had a lacklustre season after a workaholic year in 1996. Scored the winner against Barcelona in the 1995 European Cup semifinals.

Rai, forward, 31. Former Brazil captain with delicate touch who links midfield with strikers. Respected senior player and one of three spokesmen, along with Lama and Le Guen, for players in times of crisis.

Leonardo, playmaker, 27. Midfield dynamo chiefly responsible for PSG's best performances this season but lack of full fitness has also led to disappointing performances. Can win a match on his own on a good day.
Jerome Leroy, midfielder, 22. Rose to the senior squad from club's youth scheme to establish himself firmly this season as understudy for Guerin or Leonardo.
Patrice Loko, striker, 26. France international who recovered his scoring touch after a difficult start to the season. When not scoring, he works hard creating space for advancing midfielders.
Cyrille Pouget, striker, 24. Former France forward signed from Swiss club Servette in December. Generally used as second half substitute, he has scored important goals this season.

Julio Cesar Dely Valdes, striker, 29. Much travelled Panama international who has had too many ups and downs to fully gain the club's confidence. Will almost certainly leave Paris at the end of the season.
